title: `topics/clinical-neuroplasticity-evidence-for-bidirectional-causation` grades its own evidence two ways: L104 says the findings "are compatible with both interpretations, and the data do not adjudicate", yet the description says "suggestive evidence for genuine mental causation", L38 calls the convergence "a challenge to … the causal closure of the physical", and L124 opens "as evidence that mental causation is not reducible to physical causation"
